en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a metal truss bridge crossing a river or canal in a park-like landscape. In the foreground, a narrow watercourse runs alongside a curved stone embankment. Trees line the banks and several small human figures stand near the river under the bridge. At the top of the image, printed text in German reads "Torgau a. Elbe" and "Partie im Glacis."
